name: nordic_fasteners
purpose: One supplier with one item at each risk level and one history document of each kind: supplier-wide (a customs hold), one item whoever supplies it (a demand rise), one item from this supplier (a defective batch), one item with ordinary history (steady demand); the Critical item has no document. Written for v5 development on 2026-10-22; not part of the evaluation set.
known_limits: Every item has weekly sales of 100, so every suggested quantity is 2,600.

history.text: NordicFasteners shipments were held for four weeks in November 2024 after a customs documentation error at Gothenburg. The supplier says it has since changed how its export paperwork is prepared.
WasherSteel demand has risen by about 60% since January 2025, after a new construction customer started placing monthly orders.
A batch of AnchorPlug delivered by NordicFasteners in December 2024 had about 3% of units with cracked sleeves. Replacements arrived two weeks later.
CableTie demand has been steady over the past year.
